summary: Test-only: the single-send selector publication test uses an effectively unbounded per-store fold time allowance while retaining its immediate-after-commit assertion and row/subject limits. A busy host can exhaust the production 10 ms allowance after scanning a single claim, leaving a valid pending fold; the test no longer mistakes that pre-existing timing behavior for a publication regression.

replay.detail: No claim or projection replay changes.

schema.detail: Uses the existing test-only per-store fold budget; no schema changes.

rules.detail: Test only; production fold budgets and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or replicated-state changes.

downtime.detail: No runtime changes or restart required.
